dataset.name: Adult glioblastoma (CPTAC-GDC)
dataset.description: Independent adult glioblastoma cohort with open GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq STAR-counts and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: CPTAC discovery and confirmatory adult glioblastoma specimens. Only primary brain tumors diagnosed as glioblastoma are retained, and the cohort remains separate from TCGA-GBM.

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TCGA-TRACE, but matrix downloads remain disabled pending a dedicated redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: The project-level CPTAC-3 collection contains several cancers. Inclusion is prespecified as primary-site Brain and primary diagnosis Glioblastoma or Glioblastoma multiforme, followed by one primary-tumor STAR-counts file per endpoint-complete participant.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TCGA-TRACE applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
